module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundsInclusionTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptance (constantZero)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets (memberGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilter (passGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedRounds (members membersTape)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets (roundGraph)

/-- Occurrence in the output of a directed pass gives an occurrence of
the same candidate in the original vertices on that very tape. -/
def PassIncluded (E : Program 4) : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (out vertices seen ctx ty k : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((passGraph E out vertices seen ctx ty ⊓ memberGraph out k).imp
      (memberGraph vertices k)))

def RoundsIncluded (E : Program 4) : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (out fuel vertices ctx ty seed k : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((roundGraph E out fuel vertices ctx ty seed ⊓ memberGraph out k).imp
      (memberGraph vertices k)))

def MembersIncluded (E : Program 4) : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (out vertices ctx ty seed k : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      ((programGraph (members E) out (membersTape vertices ctx ty seed) ⊓ memberGraph out k).imp
        (memberGraph vertices k)))

/-- Both filters are explicit: the literal zero edge at the base and the
actual E in the successor case. Membership is recovered at the original
vertices both at any genuine open fuel and at the genuine chosen length. -/
def ExactRoundsInclusionFromPass : Prop :=
  ∀ E : Program 4, PassIncluded (constantZero 4) → PassIncluded E →
    RoundsIncluded E ∧ MembersIncluded E

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundsInclusionTargets

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenMinimumRowsProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalListInductionProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalClosedProgramsBindingProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenInductionProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalListCodecSupportProof (consGraph)
open ID1Completion.InternalListInduction (atCode atIndex constructorBody constructors premises)
open ID1Completion.InternalListInductionProof (actualOriginalListInductionAtCode)
open ID1Completion.InternalClosedProgramsBindingProof (actualFiniteUniversalIntroduction)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (z)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenSyntaxProof (invariant invariantCode invariantIndex)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenMinimumRowsProof (minimumNil minimumCons)

private theorem constructorDerivation (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type)
    (Γ : List (Formula α)) (k : OTerm α) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (constructors (invariant k))) := by
  apply actualFiniteUniversalIntroduction body α 3 Γ (constructorBody (invariant k))
  let j : α → α ⊕ Fin 3 := Sum.inl
  let n : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 3) := .var (.inr 0)
  let h : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 3) := .var (.inr 1)
  let t : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 3) := .var (.inr 2)
  let C := consGraph n h t
  let R := selectedOccurs t (k.relabel j)
  let Δ := R :: C :: Γ.map (fun p => p.relabel j)
  change Nonempty (Derivation body (Γ.map (fun p => p.relabel j))
    (C.imp ((atIndex (invariant k) 2).imp (atIndex (invariant k) 0))))
  simp only [invariantIndex]
  obtain ⟨out⟩ := minimumCons (body := body) (Γ := Δ) n h t (k.relabel j)
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)⟩
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction (Derivation.implicationIntroduction out)⟩

/-- The induction is inside the original arithmetic proof calculus.
The candidate is arbitrary and fixed; the scratch list code is the
single quantity generalized by the actual list induction schema. -/
theorem occurs : ExactOpenScratchMinimumOccurs := by
  intro body α Γ code k
  have base : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (atCode (invariant k) z)) := by
    rw [invariantCode]
    exact minimumNil k
  obtain ⟨base⟩ := base
  obtain ⟨step⟩ := constructorDerivation body α Γ k
  have original : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (premises (invariant k))) :=
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction base step⟩
  have current := actualOriginalListInductionAtCode body α Γ (invariant k) code original
  rw [invariantCode] at current
  exact current

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenInductionProof

public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalListCodecSupportProof
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserOpenSyntaxProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSupportProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenMemberConsProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalListCodecSupportProof (consGraph consGraphRename)
open ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionProof (consValue)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof (programCases)
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof (renameInto)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (eqn eqnRelabel)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSupportProof (symm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (suc z)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserOpenSyntaxProof (binaryInputsRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembership
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenSyntaxProof (graphRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenRowProof (stepHit stepKeep)

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

/-- Head occurrence at the same actual cons; obtain the genuine recursive
value using original Program totality, never a default tail bit. -/
theorem headMember (code h tail k : OTerm α)
    (cell : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (consGraph code h tail)))
    (same : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn k h))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph code k)) := by
  apply programCases scratchMember ![tail,k] (memberGraph code k)
  intro β j Δ previous keep observed
  rw [graphRename]
  rw [binaryInputsRename] at observed
  have hasCell := renameInto cell j Δ keep
  rw [consGraphRename] at hasCell
  have equals := renameInto same j Δ keep
  rw [eqnRelabel] at equals
  obtain ⟨he⟩ := equals
  let h' := h.relabel j
  let t' := tail.relabel j
  let k' := k.relabel j
  exact consValue memberBase memberStep (code.relabel j) h' t' previous (suc z) ![k']
    hasCell observed (stepHit h' previous k' ⟨symm he⟩)

theorem tailMember (code h tail k : OTerm α)
    (cell : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (consGraph code h tail)))
    (member : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph tail k))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph code k)) :=
  consValue memberBase memberStep code h tail (suc z) (suc z) ![k] cell member (stepKeep h k)

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenMemberConsProof

10	public section
11	namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenMinimumRowsProof
12	open FirstOrder Language
13	open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
14	open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
15	open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
16	open ID1Completion.InternalListCodecSupportProof (consGraph)
17	open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptance (constantZero)
18	open ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionProof (nilRecover)
19	open ID1Completion.InternalLessThanSupportProof (zeroConstantValue)
20	open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (valueUnique)
21	open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (eqn)
22	open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSupportProof (sucNeZeroApply)
23	open ID1Completion.InternalBetaTotalityProof (disjunctionElimination addHyp)
24	open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (suc z unary)
25	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimum (minimumStep scratchMinimum)
26	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimumOpenChecks (exact_OpenScratchMinimumCons)
27	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets
28	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenMemberConsProof (headMember tailMember)
29	
30	attribute [local irreducible] programGraph
31	
32	variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}
33	
34	/-- The actual minimum at nil has no successful witness. Not even the
35	actual value zero is inserted by the membership antecedent. -/
36	theorem minimumNil (k : OTerm α) :
37	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (selectedOccurs z k)) := by
38	  let A := unary scratchMinimum (suc k) z
39	  let Δ := A :: Γ
40	  let empty : Fin 0 → OTerm α := Fin.elim0
41	  have input : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ A) := ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
42	  have result := nilRecover (constantZero 0) minimumStep (suc k) empty input
43	  obtain ⟨contradiction⟩ := valueUnique (constantZero 0) (suc k) z empty result
44	    (zeroConstantValue empty)
45	  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction (Derivation.explosion (sucNeZeroApply contradiction))⟩
46	
47	/-- One actual cons induction step, using the accepted same-head or
48	same-tail minimum disjunction and genuine membership introductions. -/
49	theorem minimumCons (code h tail k : OTerm α)
50	    (cell : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (consGraph code h tail)))
51	    (inherited : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (selectedOccurs tail k))) :
52	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (selectedOccurs code k)) := by
53	  let A := unary scratchMinimum (suc k) code
54	  let L := eqn k h
55	  let R := unary scratchMinimum (suc k) tail
56	  let Δ := A :: Γ
57	  obtain ⟨c⟩ := cell
58	  obtain ⟨ih⟩ := inherited
59	  obtain ⟨step⟩ := exact_OpenScratchMinimumCons body α Δ code h tail k
60	  have split := Derivation.implicationElimination step
61	    (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction (addHyp c A) (Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self))
62	  obtain ⟨left⟩ := headMember (body := body) (Γ := L :: Δ) code h tail k
63	    ⟨addHyp (addHyp c A) L⟩ ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
64	  have already : Derivation body (R :: Δ) (memberGraph tail k) :=
65	    Derivation.implicationElimination (addHyp (addHyp ih A) R) (Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self)
66	  obtain ⟨right⟩ := tailMember (body := body) (Γ := R :: Δ) code h tail k
67	    ⟨addHyp (addHyp c A) R⟩ ⟨already⟩
68	  have actual := disjunctionElimination split
69	    (Derivation.implicationIntroduction left) (Derivation.implicationIntroduction right)
70	  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction actual⟩
71	
72	end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenMinimumRowsProof

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

/-- The actual minimum at nil has no successful witness. Not even the
actual value zero is inserted by the membership antecedent. -/
theorem minimumNil (k : OTerm α) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (selectedOccurs z k)) := by
  let A := unary scratchMinimum (suc k) z
  let Δ := A :: Γ
  let empty : Fin 0 → OTerm α := Fin.elim0
  have input : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ A) := ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
  have result := nilRecover (constantZero 0) minimumStep (suc k) empty input
  obtain ⟨contradiction⟩ := valueUnique (constantZero 0) (suc k) z empty result
    (zeroConstantValue empty)
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction (Derivation.explosion (sucNeZeroApply contradiction))⟩

/-- One actual cons induction step, using the accepted same-head or
same-tail minimum disjunction and genuine membership introductions. -/
theorem minimumCons (code h tail k : OTerm α)
    (cell : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (consGraph code h tail)))
    (inherited : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (selectedOccurs tail k))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (selectedOccurs code k)) := by
  let A := unary scratchMinimum (suc k) code
  let L := eqn k h
  let R := unary scratchMinimum (suc k) tail
  let Δ := A :: Γ
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := cell
  obtain ⟨ih⟩ := inherited
  obtain ⟨step⟩ := exact_OpenScratchMinimumCons body α Δ code h tail k
  have split := Derivation.implicationElimination step
    (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction (addHyp c A) (Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self))
  obtain ⟨left⟩ := headMember (body := body) (Γ := L :: Δ) code h tail k
    ⟨addHyp (addHyp c A) L⟩ ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
  have already : Derivation body (R :: Δ) (memberGraph tail k) :=
    Derivation.implicationElimination (addHyp (addHyp ih A) R) (Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self)
  obtain ⟨right⟩ := tailMember (body := body) (Γ := R :: Δ) code h tail k
    ⟨addHyp (addHyp c A) R⟩ ⟨already⟩
  have actual := disjunctionElimination split
    (Derivation.implicationIntroduction left) (Derivation.implicationIntroduction right)
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction actual⟩

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenMinimumRowsProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilter
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge GorbowPRProgram
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptance (branch constantZero)
open ID1Completion.InternalListCodec (consCode)
open ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursion (listRec)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (eqn)
open GorbowVerifierNormalization (normalize)
open SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof (existsOne)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedSeen (scan scanGraph)

abbrev passTape {T : Type} (vertices seen ctx ty : T) : Fin 4 → T := ![vertices,seen,ctx,ty]
abbrev filterTape {T : Type} (v rest seen ctx ty : T) : Fin 5 → T := ![v,rest,seen,ctx,ty]

/-- From [v,actual filtered tail,seen,ctx,ty] select the original fixed
seen, ctx, ty and this occurrence v, in that order. -/
def scanHead (E : Program 4) : Program 5 :=
  .composition (scan E) ![.projection 2,.projection 3,.projection 4,.projection 0]

/-- Prepend this one literal occurrence to the actual filtered tail. -/
def prependHead : Program 5 :=
  .composition consCode ![.projection 0,.projection 1]

/-- Skip the head on rejection, otherwise retain it in its original order.
The previous output is never substituted for the fixed seen input. -/
def filterStep (E : Program 4) : Program 5 :=
  branch (normalize (scanHead E)) (.projection 1) prependHead

/-- One right-to-left physical pass of the literal source filter. Nil emits
the scratch nil; selected heads are prepended, not appended to seen. -/
def pass (E : Program 4) : Program 4 :=
  listRec (constantZero 3) (filterStep E)

abbrev cell {α : Type} (code h t : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  programGraph consCode code ![h,t]

def passGraph (E : Program 4) {α : Type} (out vertices seen ctx ty : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  programGraph (pass E) out (passTape vertices seen ctx ty)

def restRow (E : Program 4) {α : Type} (out h tail rest seen ctx ty : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  passGraph E rest tail seen ctx ty ⊓
    ((scanGraph E seen ctx ty h ⊓ cell out h rest) ⊔
      ((scanGraph E seen ctx ty h).not ⊓ eqn out rest))

/-- Both branches share one genuine result of filtering this actual tail. -/
def restReport (E : Program 4) {α : Type} (out h tail seen ctx ty : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  let j : α → α ⊕ Fin 1 := Sum.inl
  existsOne (restRow E (out.relabel j) (h.relabel j) (tail.relabel j) (.var (.inr 0))
    (seen.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilter

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilterDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowClassAlgorithm

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilterTargets
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedMultisetNumeric (decodeNumbers numbersNumber)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedSeen (edgeTape)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilter

/-- Every standard scratch code and actual edge AST, with the literal
source-directed advance on the two independently decoded ordered lists. -/
def ExactAllInputDirectedFilter : Prop :=
  ∀ (E : Program 4) (vertices seen ctx ty : Nat),
    evaluate (pass E) (List.Vector.ofFn (passTape vertices seen ctx ty)) =
      numbersNumber (NumberedWindowClassAlgorithm.advance
        (fun w v => decide (evaluate E (List.Vector.ofFn (edgeTape ctx ty w v)) = 1))
        ((decodeNumbers vertices).getD []) ((decodeNumbers seen).getD []))

/-- A physical input cons and its actual filtered output expose one
genuine filtered tail and the literal retain/skip object disjunction. -/
def ExactOpenDirectedFilterCons : Prop :=
  ∀ (E : Program 4) (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (vertices h tail seen ctx ty out : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      ((cell vertices h tail ⊓ passGraph E out vertices seen ctx ty).imp
        (restReport E out h tail seen ctx ty)))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilterTargets

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

/-- Expose only the actual result of the same pass on this genuine tail.
Both row alternatives share it under a single original existential. -/
private theorem decompose (E : Program 4) (vertices h tail seen ctx ty out : OTerm α)

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilterTargets
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceBranchProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceNormalizationProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphChoiceProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalQuotientComparisonProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalBetaTotalityProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilterOpenRowProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge GorbowPRProgram
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open GorbowVerifierNormalization (normalize)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceBranchProof (successorBranchElim zeroBranchElim)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceNormalizationProof (normalizeAccept normalizeReject)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof (compositionRecover)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (compositionValue projectionValue valueUnique)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphChoiceProof (excludedMiddle)
open ID1Completion.InternalQuotientComparisonProof (orLeft orRight)
open ID1Completion.InternalBetaTotalityProof (addHyp disjunctionElimination)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (eqn)
open ID1Completion.InternalListCodec (consCode)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (suc z)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedSeen (scan scanGraph scanTape)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilter

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

private theorem scanParts (h rest seen ctx ty : OTerm α) :
    ∀ i : Fin 4, Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph
      ((![.projection 2,.projection 3,.projection 4,.projection 0] : Fin 4 → Program 5) i)
      (scanTape seen ctx ty h i) (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty))) := by
  intro i
  let xs := filterTape h rest seen ctx ty
  exact Fin.cases (projectionValue 2 xs) (Fin.cases (projectionValue 3 xs)
    (Fin.cases (projectionValue 4 xs) (Fin.cases (projectionValue 0 xs)
      (fun noIndex => Fin.elim0 noIndex)))) i

private theorem selectScan (E : Program 4) (h rest seen ctx ty : OTerm α)
    (ok : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (scanGraph E seen ctx ty h))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (scanHead E) (suc z)
      (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty))) :=
  compositionValue (scan E) ![.projection 2,.projection 3,.projection 4,.projection 0]
    (suc z) (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty) (scanTape seen ctx ty h) ok
    (scanParts h rest seen ctx ty)

private theorem recoverScan (E : Program 4) (h rest seen ctx ty : OTerm α)
    (ok : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (scanHead E) (suc z)
      (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty)))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (scanGraph E seen ctx ty h)) :=
  compositionRecover (scan E) ![.projection 2,.projection 3,.projection 4,.projection 0]
    (suc z) (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty) (scanTape seen ctx ty h) ok
    (scanParts h rest seen ctx ty)

private theorem retain (E : Program 4) (out h rest seen ctx ty : OTerm α)
    (ok : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (scanHead E) (suc z)
      (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty))))
    (run : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (filterStep E) out (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty)))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (scanGraph E seen ctx ty h ⊓ cell out h rest)) := by
  let xs := filterTape h rest seen ctx ty
  have accepted := successorBranchElim (normalize (scanHead E)) (.projection 1) prependHead
    out z xs (normalizeAccept (scanHead E) xs ok) run
  have built : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (cell out h rest)) := by
    apply compositionRecover consCode (![.projection 0,.projection 1] : Fin 2 → Program 5)
      out xs (![h,rest] : Fin 2 → OTerm α) accepted
    intro i
    exact Fin.cases (projectionValue 0 xs) (Fin.cases (projectionValue 1 xs)
      (fun noIndex => Fin.elim0 noIndex)) i
  obtain ⟨chosen⟩ := recoverScan E h rest seen ctx ty ok
  obtain ⟨built⟩ := built
  exact ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction chosen built⟩

private theorem skip (E : Program 4) (out h rest seen ctx ty : OTerm α)
    (failed : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (programGraph (scanHead E) (suc z) (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty)).not))
    (run : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (filterStep E) out (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty)))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((scanGraph E seen ctx ty h).not ⊓ eqn out rest)) := by
  let xs := filterTape h rest seen ctx ty
  let Q := scanGraph E seen ctx ty h
  have rejected := zeroBranchElim (normalize (scanHead E)) (.projection 1) prependHead out xs
    (normalizeReject (scanHead E) xs failed) run
  obtain ⟨same⟩ := valueUnique (.projection (1 : Fin 5)) out rest xs rejected (projectionValue 1 xs)
  obtain ⟨notSelected⟩ := failed
  obtain ⟨selected⟩ := selectScan (body := body) (Γ := Q :: Γ) E h rest seen ctx ty
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
  have negative : Derivation body Γ (scanGraph E seen ctx ty h).not :=
    Derivation.implicationIntroduction (Derivation.implicationElimination (addHyp notSelected Q) selected)
  exact ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction negative same⟩

/-- The object negative formula is only the other physical row branch.
No converse about witnesses or semantic scan rejection is needed. -/
theorem rowCases (E : Program 4) (out h rest seen ctx ty : OTerm α)
    (run : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (filterStep E) out (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty)))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      ((scanGraph E seen ctx ty h ⊓ cell out h rest) ⊔ ((scanGraph E seen ctx ty h).not ⊓ eqn out rest))) := by
  let A := programGraph (scanHead E) (suc z) (filterTape h rest seen ctx ty)
  obtain ⟨run⟩ := run
  obtain ⟨yes⟩ := retain (body := body) (Γ := A :: Γ) E out h rest seen ctx ty
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩ ⟨addHyp run A⟩
  obtain ⟨no⟩ := skip (body := body) (Γ := A.not :: Γ) E out h rest seen ctx ty
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩ ⟨addHyp run A.not⟩
  exact ⟨disjunctionElimination (excludedMiddle A)
    (Derivation.implicationIntroduction (orLeft yes))
    (Derivation.implicationIntroduction (orRight no))⟩

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilterOpenRowProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilterOpenSyntaxProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof (existsOne)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (programRename)
open ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionSyntaxProof (programSubst)
open ID1Completion.InternalRecursionGraphStepSyntaxProof (conjunctionRename)
open ID1Completion.InternalRecursionClosureSyntaxProof (conjunctionSubst)
open ID1Completion.InternalDerivationRenamingSyntaxProof (existsRename)
open ID1Completion.InternalListCodec (consCode)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof
  (emb eqnRelabel eqnSubst bindEmbedding liftBind varBind zRelabel sucRelabel zSubst sucSubst)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserOpenSyntaxProof (binaryInputsRename quadInputsRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedSeen (scanGraph scanTape)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilter

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

private theorem orRename {α β : Type} (p q : Formula α) (j : α → β) :
    (p ⊔ q).relabel j = p.relabel j ⊔ q.relabel j := rfl

private theorem orSubst {α β : Type} (p q : Formula α) (ts : α → Term β) :
    (p ⊔ q).subst ts = p.subst ts ⊔ q.subst ts := rfl

private theorem notRename {α β : Type} (p : Formula α) (j : α → β) :
    p.not.relabel j = (p.relabel j).not := rfl

private theorem notSubst {α β : Type} (p : Formula α) (ts : α → Term β) :
    p.not.subst ts = (p.subst ts).not := rfl

private theorem graph4Rename {α β : Type} (p : Program 4) (o a b c d : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (programGraph p o ![a,b,c,d]).relabel j =
      programGraph p (o.relabel j) ![a.relabel j,b.relabel j,c.relabel j,d.relabel j] := by
  rw [programRename,quadInputsRename]

private theorem graph4Subst {α β : Type} (p : Program 4) (o a b c d : OTerm α) (t : α → OTerm β) :
    (programGraph p o ![a,b,c,d]).subst (fun x => emb (t x)) =
      programGraph p (o.subst t) ![a.subst t,b.subst t,c.subst t,d.subst t] := by
  have tape : (fun i => ((![a,b,c,d] : Fin 4 → OTerm α) i).subst t) =
      ![a.subst t,b.subst t,c.subst t,d.subst t] := by
    funext i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun x => Fin.cases ?_ (fun y => Fin.cases ?_ (fun w =>
      Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => Fin.elim0 k) w) y) x) i <;> rfl
  rw [programSubst,tape]

private theorem cellRename {α β : Type} (o h t : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (cell o h t).relabel j = cell (o.relabel j) (h.relabel j) (t.relabel j) := by
  simp only [cell,programRename,binaryInputsRename]

private theorem cellSubst {α β : Type} (o h tail : OTerm α) (ts : α → OTerm β) :
    (cell o h tail).subst (fun a => emb (ts a)) =
      cell (o.subst ts) (h.subst ts) (tail.subst ts) := by
  have tape : (fun i => ((![h,tail] : Fin 2 → OTerm α) i).subst ts) =
      ![h.subst ts,tail.subst ts] := by
    funext i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · rfl
    · obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero j
      rfl
  unfold cell
  rw [programSubst,tape]

private theorem rowRename {α β : Type} (E : Program 4)
    (o h tail rest seen ctx ty : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (restRow E o h tail rest seen ctx ty).relabel j =
      restRow E (o.relabel j) (h.relabel j) (tail.relabel j) (rest.relabel j)
        (seen.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) := by
  simp only [restRow,conjunctionRename,orRename,notRename,cellRename,eqnRelabel,
    passGraph,passTape,scanGraph,scanTape,graph4Rename,sucRelabel,zRelabel]

private theorem rowSubst {α β : Type} (E : Program 4)
    (o h tail rest seen ctx ty : OTerm α) (ts : α → OTerm β) :
    (restRow E o h tail rest seen ctx ty).subst (fun a => emb (ts a)) =
      restRow E (o.subst ts) (h.subst ts) (tail.subst ts) (rest.subst ts)
        (seen.subst ts) (ctx.subst ts) (ty.subst ts) := by
  simp only [restRow,conjunctionSubst,orSubst,notSubst,cellSubst,eqnSubst,
    passGraph,passTape,scanGraph,scanTape,graph4Subst,sucSubst,zSubst]

abbrev reportBinder (E : Program 4) {α : Type} (o h tail seen ctx ty : OTerm α) : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1) :=
  restRow E (o.relabel Sum.inl) (h.relabel Sum.inl) (tail.relabel Sum.inl) (.var (.inr 0))
    (seen.relabel Sum.inl) (ctx.relabel Sum.inl) (ty.relabel Sum.inl)

theorem reportUnfold (E : Program 4) {α : Type} (o h tail seen ctx ty : OTerm α) :
    restReport E o h tail seen ctx ty = existsOne (reportBinder E o h tail seen ctx ty) := rfl

theorem reportInstance (E : Program 4) {α : Type} (o h tail rest seen ctx ty : OTerm α) :
    instantiate (reportBinder E o h tail seen ctx ty) (emb rest) = restRow E o h tail rest seen ctx ty := by
  simp only [instantiate,reportBinder,bindEmbedding,rowSubst,liftBind,varBind]

theorem reportRename {α β : Type} (E : Program 4) (o h tail seen ctx ty : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (restReport E o h tail seen ctx ty).relabel j =
      restReport E (o.relabel j) (h.relabel j) (tail.relabel j) (seen.relabel j)
        (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) := by
  rw [reportUnfold,reportUnfold,existsRename]
  unfold reportBinder
  rw [rowRename]
  simp only [Term.relabel_relabel] <;> rfl

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilterOpenSyntaxProof

open FirstOrder Language

open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathSuccessfulAdvanceGraphSyntaxProof (unarySubst)

open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimum (scratchMinimum)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

theorem graphRename {α β : Type} (code k : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (memberGraph code k).relabel j = memberGraph (code.relabel j) (k.relabel j) := by
  unfold memberGraph
  rw [programRename,binaryInputsRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel]

private theorem graphSubst {α β : Type} (code k : OTerm α) (ts : α → OTerm β) :
    (memberGraph code k).subst (fun a => emb (ts a)) = memberGraph (code.subst ts) (k.subst ts) := by
  have tape : (fun i => ((![code,k] : Fin 2 → OTerm α) i).subst ts) =
      ![code.subst ts,k.subst ts] := by
    funext i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · rfl
    · obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero j
      rfl
  unfold memberGraph
  rw [programSubst,tape,sucSubst,zSubst]

private theorem occursRename {α β : Type} (code k : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (selectedOccurs code k).relabel j = selectedOccurs (code.relabel j) (k.relabel j) := by
  change ((unary scratchMinimum (suc k) code).relabel j).imp ((memberGraph code k).relabel j) = _
  rw [unaryRename,graphRename,sucRelabel] <;> rfl

private theorem occursSubst {α β : Type} (code k : OTerm α) (ts : α → OTerm β) :
    (selectedOccurs code k).subst (fun a => emb (ts a)) =
      selectedOccurs (code.subst ts) (k.subst ts) := by
  simp only [selectedOccurs,impSubst,unarySubst,graphSubst,sucSubst]

/-- Fixed arithmetic candidate; only the real scratch code is generalized. -/
abbrev invariant {α : Type} (k : OTerm α) : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1) :=
  selectedOccurs (.var (.inr 0)) (k.relabel Sum.inl)

theorem invariantCode {α : Type} (k n : OTerm α) :
    atCode (invariant k) n = selectedOccurs n k := by
  rw [atCode,instantiate,bindEmbedding]
  change (selectedOccurs (.var (.inr 0)) (k.relabel Sum.inl)).subst _ = _
  rw [occursSubst]
  simp only [liftBind,varBind]

theorem invariantIndex {α : Type} (k : OTerm α) (i : Fin 3) :
    atIndex (invariant k) i = selectedOccurs (.var (.inr i)) (k.relabel Sum.inl) := by
  unfold atIndex
  change (selectedOccurs (.var (.inr 0)) (k.relabel Sum.inl)).relabel _ = _
  rw [occursRename]
  simp only [Term.relabel_relabel,Term.relabel] <;> rfl

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenSyntaxProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundsInclusionProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptance (constantZero)
open ID1Completion.InternalListCodec (consCode)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof (programCases)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (programRename headTransport zeroSuccessorCases)
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof (renameInto)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (eqn zRelabel sucRelabel)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (z suc)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilter (cell)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedRounds
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets (roundGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsChecks
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets (memberGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenSyntaxProof (graphRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserOpenSyntaxProof (binaryInputsRename quadInputsRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDecodeSyntaxProof (unaryInputsRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundsInclusionTargets

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph
variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

private theorem tapeRename {α β : Type} (n vertices ctx ty seed : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (fun i => (roundsTape n vertices ctx ty seed i).relabel j) =
      roundsTape (n.relabel j) (vertices.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j) := by
  funext i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun a => Fin.cases ?_ (fun b => Fin.cases ?_ (fun c =>
    Fin.cases ?_ (fun d => Fin.cases ?_ (fun e => Fin.elim0 e) d) c) b) a) i <;> rfl

private theorem roundRename {α β : Type} (E : Program 4)
    (out n vertices ctx ty seed : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (roundGraph E out n vertices ctx ty seed).relabel j = roundGraph E (out.relabel j)
      (n.relabel j) (vertices.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j) := by
  simp only [roundGraph,programRename,tapeRename]

private theorem atZero (E : Program 4) (subset : PassIncluded (constantZero 4))
    (out vertices ctx ty seed k : OTerm α)
    (round : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (roundGraph E out z vertices ctx ty seed)))
    (member : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph out k))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph vertices k)) := by
  apply programCases consCode ![seed,z] _
  intro β j Δ singleton keep hs
  rw [graphRename]
  rw [binaryInputsRename,zRelabel] at hs
  have hr := renameInto round j Δ keep
  rw [roundRename,zRelabel] at hr
  have hm := renameInto member j Δ keep
  rw [graphRename] at hm
  obtain ⟨step⟩ := exact_OpenRoundZero E body β Δ (out.relabel j) (vertices.relabel j)
    (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j) singleton
  obtain ⟨inc⟩ := subset body β Δ (out.relabel j) (vertices.relabel j) singleton
    (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (k.relabel j)
  obtain ⟨h⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨m⟩ := hm
  have pass := Derivation.implicationElimination
    (Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.implicationElimination step h)) r
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationElimination inc (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction pass m)⟩

private theorem atSucc (E : Program 4) (subset : PassIncluded E)
    (out fuel vertices ctx ty seed k : OTerm α)
    (round : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (roundGraph E out (suc fuel) vertices ctx ty seed)))
    (member : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph out k))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph vertices k)) := by
  apply programCases (rounds E) (roundsTape fuel vertices ctx ty seed) _
  intro β j Δ previous keep hp
  rw [graphRename]
  rw [tapeRename] at hp
  have hr := renameInto round j Δ keep
  rw [roundRename,sucRelabel] at hr
  have hm := renameInto member j Δ keep
  rw [graphRename] at hm
  obtain ⟨step⟩ := exact_OpenRoundSuccessor E body β Δ (out.relabel j) (fuel.relabel j)
    (vertices.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j) previous
  obtain ⟨inc⟩ := subset body β Δ (out.relabel j) (vertices.relabel j) previous
    (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (k.relabel j)
  obtain ⟨h⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨m⟩ := hm
  have pass := Derivation.implicationElimination
    (Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.implicationElimination step h)) r
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationElimination inc (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction pass m)⟩

private theorem allFuels (E : Program 4) (base : PassIncluded (constantZero 4))
    (step : PassIncluded E) (out fuel vertices ctx ty seed k : OTerm α)
    (round : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (roundGraph E out fuel vertices ctx ty seed)))
    (member : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph out k))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph vertices k)) := by
  apply zeroSuccessorCases Γ fuel _
  · obtain ⟨r⟩ := round
    obtain ⟨m⟩ := member
    let Δ := eqn fuel z :: Γ
    have moved : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (roundGraph E out z vertices ctx ty seed)) :=
      headTransport (rounds E) out fuel z (membersTape vertices ctx ty seed)
        ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
        ⟨ID1Completion.InternalBetaTotalityProof.addHyp r _⟩
    exact atZero E base out vertices ctx ty seed k moved
      ⟨ID1Completion.InternalBetaTotalityProof.addHyp m _⟩
  · intro β j Δ previous keep eq
    rw [graphRename]
    have rr := renameInto round j Δ keep
    rw [roundRename] at rr
    have mm := renameInto member j Δ keep
    rw [graphRename] at mm
    have moved := headTransport (rounds E) (out.relabel j) (fuel.relabel j) (suc previous)
      (membersTape (vertices.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j)) eq rr
    exact atSucc E step (out.relabel j) previous (vertices.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j)
      (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j) (k.relabel j) moved mm

private theorem atMembers (E : Program 4) (inc : RoundsIncluded E)
    (out vertices ctx ty seed k : OTerm α)
    (selected : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (programGraph (members E) out (membersTape vertices ctx ty seed))))
    (member : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph out k))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph vertices k)) := by
  apply programCases poolLength ![vertices] _
  intro β j Δ fuel keep len
  rw [graphRename]
  rw [unaryInputsRename] at len
  have mm := renameInto member j Δ keep
  rw [graphRename] at mm
  have ss := renameInto selected j Δ keep
  simp only [programRename,membersTape,quadInputsRename] at ss
  obtain ⟨atLength⟩ := exact_OpenMembersAtLength E body β Δ (out.relabel j) fuel
    (vertices.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j)
  obtain ⟨rule⟩ := inc body β Δ (out.relabel j) fuel (vertices.relabel j) (ctx.relabel j)
    (ty.relabel j) (seed.relabel j) (k.relabel j)
  obtain ⟨l⟩ := len
  obtain ⟨s⟩ := ss
  obtain ⟨m⟩ := mm
  have rr := Derivation.implicationElimination
    (Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.implicationElimination atLength l)) s
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationElimination rule (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction rr m)⟩

theorem transport : ExactRoundsInclusionFromPass := by
  intro E base step
  have roundsRule : RoundsIncluded E := by
    intro body α Γ out fuel vertices ctx ty seed k
    let P := roundGraph E out fuel vertices ctx ty seed ⊓ memberGraph out k
    have h : Derivation body (P :: Γ) P := Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self
    obtain ⟨proof⟩ := allFuels E base step out fuel vertices ctx ty seed k
      ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft h⟩ ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight h⟩
    exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction proof⟩
  refine ⟨roundsRule,?_⟩
  intro body α Γ out vertices ctx ty seed k
  let P := programGraph (members E) out (membersTape vertices ctx ty seed) ⊓ memberGraph out k
  have h : Derivation body (P :: Γ) P := Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self
  obtain ⟨proof⟩ := atMembers E roundsRule out vertices ctx ty seed k
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft h⟩ ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight h⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction proof⟩

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRoundsInclusionProof

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalListCodecDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalClosedProgramsDefinitions
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalListInduction
open FirstOrder Language PositiveArithmeticOperators InternalCalculus InternalControlGraph
open InternalClosedPrograms InternalListCodec SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof

/-- Substitute an arbitrary object-language code into a full-language invariant. -/
def atCode {α : Type} (theta : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1))
    (n : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α) : Formula α :=
  instantiate theta (arithmeticEmbedding.onTerm n)

/-- Preserve every free parameter and select one of the three bound codes.
The coordinates are the constructed code, its head, and its tail. -/
def atIndex {α : Type} (theta : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)) (i : Fin 3) :
    Formula (α ⊕ Fin 3) :=
  theta.relabel (Sum.elim Sum.inl (fun _ => Sum.inr i))

/-- The literal successor-of-pair constructor graph, with induction on its
tail. Neither canonicality nor an externally decoded list is assumed. -/
def constructorBody {α : Type} (theta : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)) :
    Formula (α ⊕ Fin 3) :=
  (programGraph consCode (.var (.inr 0))
    (Fin.cons (.var (.inr 1)) (Fin.cons (.var (.inr 2)) Fin.elim0))).imp
      ((atIndex theta 2).imp (atIndex theta 0))

def constructors {α : Type} (theta : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)) : Formula α :=
  allBlock (constructorBody theta)

def premises {α : Type} (theta : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)) : Formula α :=
  atCode theta OrdinaryArithmetic.zeroTerm ⊓ constructors theta

/-- List-code induction as one actual first-order theorem. The invariant may
contain the inductive predicate, arbitrary negation, and arbitrary parameters. -/
def schema {α : Type} (theta : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)) : Formula α :=
  (premises theta).imp (allOne theta)

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalListInduction

1	module
2	public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionTableProof
3	public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionNextProof
4	@[expose] public section
5	namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionProof
6	open FirstOrder Language PositiveArithmeticOperators InternalCalculus InternalControlGraph
7	open InternalRawListRecursion InternalRawListRecursionSyntaxProof InternalRawListRecursionSupportProof
8	open InternalRawListRecursionTableProof InternalRawListRecursionNextProof
9	open InternalListCodec SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof
10	open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
11	open InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof InternalTagArithmeticSupportProof
12	open InternalControlGraphSupportProof InternalAcceptanceSupportProof InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof
13	open InternalRecursionGraphStepSyntaxProof InternalListCodecSupportProof InternalListCodecDecompositionSupportProof
14	open InternalPositiveUnfoldingSupportProof InternalAdditionLawsProof InternalOriginalOrderSyntaxProof
15	
16	variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Gamma : List (Formula α)}
17	
18	theorem nilValue {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
19	    (out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
20	    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph base out params))) :
21	    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out z params)) := by
22	  apply programCases consCode (Fin.cons out (Fin.cons z Fin.elim0)) _
23	  intro β j Delta tab hj hc
24	  simp only [recRename,zRelabel]
25	  simp only [consTermRename,zRelabel,emptyRename] at hc
26	  have h' := renameInto h j Delta hj
27	  rw [programRename] at h'
28	  have ht := tableZeroValue base step (out.relabel j) tab (fun i => (params i).relabel j) h' hc
29	  exact recValue base step (out.relabel j) z tab (fun i => (params i).relabel j) ht
30	    (consHead tab (out.relabel j) z hc)
31	
32	theorem nilRecover {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
33	    (out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
34	    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out z params))) :
35	    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph base out params)) := by
36	  apply programCases base params _
37	  intro β j Delta value hj hv
38	  rw [programRename]
39	  have h' := renameInto h j Delta hj
40	  simp only [recRename,zRelabel] at h'
41	  obtain ⟨he⟩ := valueUnique (listRec base step) value (out.relabel j)
42	    (Fin.cons z (fun i => (params i).relabel j))
43	    (nilValue base step value (fun i => (params i).relabel j) hv) h'
44	  exact outputTransport base value (out.relabel j) (fun i => (params i).relabel j) ⟨he⟩ hv
45	
46	theorem successorValue {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
47	    (out index previous : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
48	    (hp : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (tableGraph base step previous index params)))
49	    (hv : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (nextValue step) out
50	      (Fin.cons index (Fin.cons previous params))))) :
51	    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out (suc index) params)) := by
52	  apply programCases consCode (Fin.cons out (Fin.cons previous Fin.elim0)) _
53	  intro β j Delta tab hj hc
54	  simp only [recRename,sucRelabel]
55	  simp only [consTermRename,emptyRename] at hc
56	  have hp' := renameInto hp j Delta hj
57	  rw [tableRename] at hp'
58	  have hv' := renameInto hv j Delta hj
59	  simp only [programRename,consTermRename] at hv'
60	  have ht := tableNext base step (out.relabel j) tab (index.relabel j) (previous.relabel j)
61	    (fun i => (params i).relabel j) hp' hv' hc
62	  exact recValue base step (out.relabel j) (suc (index.relabel j)) tab
63	    (fun i => (params i).relabel j) ht (consHead tab (out.relabel j) (previous.relabel j) hc)
64	
65	theorem consAtGap {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
66	    (head tail gap result out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
67	    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consGraph (suc (add tail gap)) head tail)))
68	    (hr : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step result tail params)))
69	    (hs : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph step out (Fin.cons head (Fin.cons result params))))) :
70	    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out (suc (add tail gap)) params)) := by
71	  apply programCases (table base step) (Fin.cons (add tail gap) params) _
72	  intro β j Delta previous hj hp
73	  simp only [recRename,sucRelabel,addRelabel]
74	  simp only [consTermRename,addRelabel] at hp
75	  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
76	  simp only [consGraphRename,sucRelabel,addRelabel] at hc'
77	  have hr' := renameInto hr j Delta hj
78	  rw [recRename] at hr'
79	  have hs' := renameInto hs j Delta hj
80	  simp only [programRename,consTermRename] at hs'
81	  let h := head.relabel j
82	  let t := tail.relabel j
83	  let g := gap.relabel j
84	  let r := result.relabel j
85	  let o := out.relabel j
86	  let ps := fun i => (params i).relabel j
87	  have hh := consHead (suc (add t g)) h t hc'
88	  have ht := consTail (suc (add t g)) h t hc'
89	  have hd := InternalEqualityTestSubtractionProof.diagonal (body := body) (Gamma := Delta) t g
90	  have hl := tableLookup base step r t g previous ps hr' hp
91	  have hn := nextValueAt step (add t g) previous h t g r o ps hh ht hd hl hs'
92	  exact successorValue base step o (add t g) previous ps hp hn
93	
94	/-- Strict descent of the original tail supplies the difference witness
95	needed by the literal table lookup and subtraction programs. -/
96	theorem consValue {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
97	    (code head tail result out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
98	    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consGraph code head tail)))
99	    (hr : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step result tail params)))
100	    (hs : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph step out (Fin.cons head (Fin.cons result params))))) :
101	    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out code params)) := by
102	  have ht := consTailDescent code head tail hc
103	  apply InternalOriginalOrderProof.orderCases Gamma tail code _ ht
104	  intro β j Delta gap hj he
105	  rw [recRename]
106	  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
107	  rw [consGraphRename] at hc'
108	  have hr' := renameInto hr j Delta hj
109	  rw [recRename] at hr'
110	  have hs' := renameInto hs j Delta hj
111	  simp only [programRename,consTermRename] at hs'
112	  obtain ⟨he⟩ := he
113	  let t := tail.relabel j
114	  have hn : Derivation body Delta (eqn (suc (add t gap)) (code.relabel j)) :=
115	    trans (symm (addSucc t gap)) he
116	  have hc'' := outputTransport consCode (code.relabel j) (suc (add t gap))
117	    (Fin.cons (head.relabel j) (Fin.cons t Fin.elim0)) ⟨symm hn⟩ hc'
118	  have hrec := consAtGap base step (head.relabel j) t gap (result.relabel j)
119	    (out.relabel j) (fun i => (params i).relabel j) hc'' hr' hs'
120	  exact headTransport (listRec base step) (out.relabel j) (suc (add t gap)) (code.relabel j)
121	    (fun i => (params i).relabel j) ⟨hn⟩ hrec
122	
123	theorem stepIntroduction {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
124	    (out head tail result : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
125	    (hr : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step result tail params)))
126	    (hs : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph step out (Fin.cons head (Fin.cons result params))))) :
127	    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consStep base step out head tail params)) := by
128	  obtain ⟨hr⟩ := hr
129	  obtain ⟨hs⟩ := hs
130	  apply Nonempty.intro
131	  apply Derivation.existentialIntroduction (emb result)
132	  rw [consStepInstance]
133	  exact Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction hr hs
134	
135	theorem stepCases {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
136	    (out head tail : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α) (psi : Formula α)
137	    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consStep base step out head tail params)))
138	    (next : ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Delta : List (Formula β)) (result : OTerm β),
139	      (∀ p ∈ Gamma, p.relabel j ∈ Delta) →
140	      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (recGraph base step result (tail.relabel j)
141	        (fun i => (params i).relabel j))) →
142	      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (programGraph step (out.relabel j)
143	        (Fin.cons (head.relabel j) (Fin.cons result (fun i => (params i).relabel j))))) →
144	      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (psi.relabel j))) :
145	    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma psi) := by
146	  obtain ⟨h⟩ := h
147	  let P := recGraph base step (.var (.inr (0 : Fin 1))) (tail.relabel Sum.inl)
148	      (fun i => (params i).relabel Sum.inl) ⊓
149	    programGraph step (out.relabel Sum.inl)
150	      (Fin.cons (head.relabel Sum.inl) (Fin.cons (.var (.inr 0)) (fun i => (params i).relabel Sum.inl)))
151	  let Delta := P :: Gamma.map weaken
152	  obtain ⟨d⟩ := next (α ⊕ Fin 1) Sum.inl Delta (.var (.inr 0))
153	    (fun p hp => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩))
154	    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self)⟩
155	    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self)⟩
156	  exact ⟨Derivation.existentialElimination h d⟩
157	
158	theorem consForward {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
159	    (code head tail out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
160	    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consGraph code head tail)))
161	    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out code params))) :
162	    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consStep base step out head tail params)) := by
163	  apply programCases (listRec base step) (Fin.cons tail params) _
164	  intro β j Delta result hj hr
165	  rw [consStepRename]
166	  simp only [consTermRename] at hr
167	  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
168	  rw [consGraphRename] at hc'
169	  have h' := renameInto h j Delta hj
170	  rw [recRename] at h'
171	  apply programCases step
172	    (Fin.cons (head.relabel j) (Fin.cons result (fun i => (params i).relabel j))) _
173	  intro γ l Theta value hl hs
174	  rw [consStepRename]
175	  simp only [consTermRename] at hs
176	  have hc'' := renameInto hc' l Theta hl
177	  rw [consGraphRename] at hc''
178	  have h'' := renameInto h' l Theta hl
179	  rw [recRename] at h''
180	  have hr' := renameInto hr l Theta hl
181	  simp only [programRename,consTermRename] at hr'
182	  let ps := fun i => ((params i).relabel j).relabel l
183	  have hv := consValue base step ((code.relabel j).relabel l) ((head.relabel j).relabel l)
184	    ((tail.relabel j).relabel l) (result.relabel l) value ps hc'' hr' hs
185	  have he := valueUnique (listRec base step) value ((out.relabel j).relabel l)
186	    (Fin.cons ((code.relabel j).relabel l) ps) hv h''
187	  have hs' := outputTransport step value ((out.relabel j).relabel l)
188	    (Fin.cons ((head.relabel j).relabel l) (Fin.cons (result.relabel l) ps)) he hs
189	  exact stepIntroduction base step ((out.relabel j).relabel l) ((head.relabel j).relabel l)
190	    ((tail.relabel j).relabel l) (result.relabel l) ps hr' hs'
191	
192	theorem consBackward {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
193	    (code head tail out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
194	    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consGraph code head tail)))
195	    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consStep base step out head tail params))) :
196	    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out code params)) := by
197	  apply stepCases base step out head tail params _ h
198	  intro β j Delta result hj hr hs
199	  rw [recRename]
200	  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
201	  rw [consGraphRename] at hc'
202	  exact consValue base step (code.relabel j) (head.relabel j) (tail.relabel j) result
203	    (out.relabel j) (fun i => (params i).relabel j) hc' hr hs
204	
205	theorem actualOriginalListRecursionZero : InternalRawListRecursionTargets.ActualOriginalListRecursionZero := by
206	  intro body k base step α out params
207	  obtain ⟨forward⟩ := nilRecover (body := body) base step out params
208	    (show Nonempty (Derivation body [recGraph base step out z params] _) from
209	      ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩)
210	  obtain ⟨backward⟩ := nilValue (body := body) base step out params
211	    (show Nonempty (Derivation body [programGraph base out params] _) from
212	      ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩)
213	  exact ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction (Derivation.implicationIntroduction forward)
214	    (Derivation.implicationIntroduction backward)⟩
215	
216	theorem actualOriginalListRecursionCons : InternalRawListRecursionTargets.ActualOriginalListRecursionCons := by
217	  intro body k base step α code head tail out params
218	  let C := consGraph code head tail
219	  let R := recGraph base step out code params
220	  let S := consStep base step out head tail params
221	  obtain ⟨forward⟩ := consForward (body := body) (Gamma := [R,C]) base step code head tail out params
222	    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)⟩
223	    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
224	  obtain ⟨backward⟩ := consBackward (body := body) (Gamma := [S,C]) base step code head tail out params
225	    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)⟩
226	    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
227	  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction
228	    (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction (Derivation.implicationIntroduction forward)
229	      (Derivation.implicationIntroduction backward))⟩
230	
231	end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionProof

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionTableProof
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionNextProof
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionProof
open FirstOrder Language PositiveArithmeticOperators InternalCalculus InternalControlGraph
open InternalRawListRecursion InternalRawListRecursionSyntaxProof InternalRawListRecursionSupportProof
open InternalRawListRecursionTableProof InternalRawListRecursionNextProof
open InternalListCodec SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof InternalTagArithmeticSupportProof
open InternalControlGraphSupportProof InternalAcceptanceSupportProof InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof
open InternalRecursionGraphStepSyntaxProof InternalListCodecSupportProof InternalListCodecDecompositionSupportProof
open InternalPositiveUnfoldingSupportProof InternalAdditionLawsProof InternalOriginalOrderSyntaxProof

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Gamma : List (Formula α)}

theorem nilValue {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
    (out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph base out params))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out z params)) := by
  apply programCases consCode (Fin.cons out (Fin.cons z Fin.elim0)) _
  intro β j Delta tab hj hc
  simp only [recRename,zRelabel]
  simp only [consTermRename,zRelabel,emptyRename] at hc
  have h' := renameInto h j Delta hj
  rw [programRename] at h'
  have ht := tableZeroValue base step (out.relabel j) tab (fun i => (params i).relabel j) h' hc
  exact recValue base step (out.relabel j) z tab (fun i => (params i).relabel j) ht
    (consHead tab (out.relabel j) z hc)

theorem nilRecover {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
    (out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out z params))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph base out params)) := by
  apply programCases base params _
  intro β j Delta value hj hv
  rw [programRename]
  have h' := renameInto h j Delta hj
  simp only [recRename,zRelabel] at h'
  obtain ⟨he⟩ := valueUnique (listRec base step) value (out.relabel j)
    (Fin.cons z (fun i => (params i).relabel j))
    (nilValue base step value (fun i => (params i).relabel j) hv) h'
  exact outputTransport base value (out.relabel j) (fun i => (params i).relabel j) ⟨he⟩ hv

theorem successorValue {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
    (out index previous : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
    (hp : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (tableGraph base step previous index params)))
    (hv : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (nextValue step) out
      (Fin.cons index (Fin.cons previous params))))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out (suc index) params)) := by
  apply programCases consCode (Fin.cons out (Fin.cons previous Fin.elim0)) _
  intro β j Delta tab hj hc
  simp only [recRename,sucRelabel]
  simp only [consTermRename,emptyRename] at hc
  have hp' := renameInto hp j Delta hj
  rw [tableRename] at hp'
  have hv' := renameInto hv j Delta hj
  simp only [programRename,consTermRename] at hv'
  have ht := tableNext base step (out.relabel j) tab (index.relabel j) (previous.relabel j)
    (fun i => (params i).relabel j) hp' hv' hc
  exact recValue base step (out.relabel j) (suc (index.relabel j)) tab
    (fun i => (params i).relabel j) ht (consHead tab (out.relabel j) (previous.relabel j) hc)

theorem consAtGap {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
    (head tail gap result out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consGraph (suc (add tail gap)) head tail)))
    (hr : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step result tail params)))
    (hs : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph step out (Fin.cons head (Fin.cons result params))))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out (suc (add tail gap)) params)) := by
  apply programCases (table base step) (Fin.cons (add tail gap) params) _
  intro β j Delta previous hj hp
  simp only [recRename,sucRelabel,addRelabel]
  simp only [consTermRename,addRelabel] at hp
  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
  simp only [consGraphRename,sucRelabel,addRelabel] at hc'
  have hr' := renameInto hr j Delta hj
  rw [recRename] at hr'
  have hs' := renameInto hs j Delta hj
  simp only [programRename,consTermRename] at hs'
  let h := head.relabel j
  let t := tail.relabel j
  let g := gap.relabel j
  let r := result.relabel j
  let o := out.relabel j
  let ps := fun i => (params i).relabel j
  have hh := consHead (suc (add t g)) h t hc'
  have ht := consTail (suc (add t g)) h t hc'
  have hd := InternalEqualityTestSubtractionProof.diagonal (body := body) (Gamma := Delta) t g
  have hl := tableLookup base step r t g previous ps hr' hp
  have hn := nextValueAt step (add t g) previous h t g r o ps hh ht hd hl hs'
  exact successorValue base step o (add t g) previous ps hp hn

/-- Strict descent of the original tail supplies the difference witness
needed by the literal table lookup and subtraction programs. -/
theorem consValue {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
    (code head tail result out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consGraph code head tail)))
    (hr : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step result tail params)))
    (hs : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph step out (Fin.cons head (Fin.cons result params))))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out code params)) := by
  have ht := consTailDescent code head tail hc
  apply InternalOriginalOrderProof.orderCases Gamma tail code _ ht
  intro β j Delta gap hj he
  rw [recRename]
  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
  rw [consGraphRename] at hc'
  have hr' := renameInto hr j Delta hj
  rw [recRename] at hr'
  have hs' := renameInto hs j Delta hj
  simp only [programRename,consTermRename] at hs'
  obtain ⟨he⟩ := he
  let t := tail.relabel j
  have hn : Derivation body Delta (eqn (suc (add t gap)) (code.relabel j)) :=
    trans (symm (addSucc t gap)) he
  have hc'' := outputTransport consCode (code.relabel j) (suc (add t gap))
    (Fin.cons (head.relabel j) (Fin.cons t Fin.elim0)) ⟨symm hn⟩ hc'
  have hrec := consAtGap base step (head.relabel j) t gap (result.relabel j)
    (out.relabel j) (fun i => (params i).relabel j) hc'' hr' hs'
  exact headTransport (listRec base step) (out.relabel j) (suc (add t gap)) (code.relabel j)
    (fun i => (params i).relabel j) ⟨hn⟩ hrec

theorem stepIntroduction {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
    (out head tail result : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
    (hr : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step result tail params)))
    (hs : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph step out (Fin.cons head (Fin.cons result params))))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consStep base step out head tail params)) := by
  obtain ⟨hr⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hs⟩ := hs
  apply Nonempty.intro
  apply Derivation.existentialIntroduction (emb result)
  rw [consStepInstance]
  exact Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction hr hs

theorem stepCases {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
    (out head tail : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α) (psi : Formula α)
    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consStep base step out head tail params)))
    (next : ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Delta : List (Formula β)) (result : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Gamma, p.relabel j ∈ Delta) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (recGraph base step result (tail.relabel j)
        (fun i => (params i).relabel j))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (programGraph step (out.relabel j)
        (Fin.cons (head.relabel j) (Fin.cons result (fun i => (params i).relabel j))))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (psi.relabel j))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma psi) := by
  obtain ⟨h⟩ := h
  let P := recGraph base step (.var (.inr (0 : Fin 1))) (tail.relabel Sum.inl)
      (fun i => (params i).relabel Sum.inl) ⊓
    programGraph step (out.relabel Sum.inl)
      (Fin.cons (head.relabel Sum.inl) (Fin.cons (.var (.inr 0)) (fun i => (params i).relabel Sum.inl)))
  let Delta := P :: Gamma.map weaken
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := next (α ⊕ Fin 1) Sum.inl Delta (.var (.inr 0))
    (fun p hp => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩))
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self)⟩
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight (Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self)⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.existentialElimination h d⟩

theorem consForward {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
    (code head tail out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consGraph code head tail)))
    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out code params))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consStep base step out head tail params)) := by
  apply programCases (listRec base step) (Fin.cons tail params) _
  intro β j Delta result hj hr
  rw [consStepRename]
  simp only [consTermRename] at hr
  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
  rw [consGraphRename] at hc'
  have h' := renameInto h j Delta hj
  rw [recRename] at h'
  apply programCases step
    (Fin.cons (head.relabel j) (Fin.cons result (fun i => (params i).relabel j))) _
  intro γ l Theta value hl hs
  rw [consStepRename]
  simp only [consTermRename] at hs
  have hc'' := renameInto hc' l Theta hl
  rw [consGraphRename] at hc''
  have h'' := renameInto h' l Theta hl
  rw [recRename] at h''
  have hr' := renameInto hr l Theta hl
  simp only [programRename,consTermRename] at hr'
  let ps := fun i => ((params i).relabel j).relabel l
  have hv := consValue base step ((code.relabel j).relabel l) ((head.relabel j).relabel l)
    ((tail.relabel j).relabel l) (result.relabel l) value ps hc'' hr' hs
  have he := valueUnique (listRec base step) value ((out.relabel j).relabel l)
    (Fin.cons ((code.relabel j).relabel l) ps) hv h''
  have hs' := outputTransport step value ((out.relabel j).relabel l)
    (Fin.cons ((head.relabel j).relabel l) (Fin.cons (result.relabel l) ps)) he hs
  exact stepIntroduction base step ((out.relabel j).relabel l) ((head.relabel j).relabel l)
    ((tail.relabel j).relabel l) (result.relabel l) ps hr' hs'

theorem consBackward {k : Nat} (base : Program k) (step : Program (k + 2))
    (code head tail out : OTerm α) (params : Fin k → OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consGraph code head tail)))
    (h : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (consStep base step out head tail params))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (recGraph base step out code params)) := by
  apply stepCases base step out head tail params _ h
  intro β j Delta result hj hr hs
  rw [recRename]
  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
  rw [consGraphRename] at hc'
  exact consValue base step (code.relabel j) (head.relabel j) (tail.relabel j) result
    (out.relabel j) (fun i => (params i).relabel j) hc' hr hs

theorem actualOriginalListRecursionZero : InternalRawListRecursionTargets.ActualOriginalListRecursionZero := by
  intro body k base step α out params
  obtain ⟨forward⟩ := nilRecover (body := body) base step out params
    (show Nonempty (Derivation body [recGraph base step out z params] _) from
      ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩)
  obtain ⟨backward⟩ := nilValue (body := body) base step out params
    (show Nonempty (Derivation body [programGraph base out params] _) from
      ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩)
  exact ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction (Derivation.implicationIntroduction forward)
    (Derivation.implicationIntroduction backward)⟩

theorem actualOriginalListRecursionCons : InternalRawListRecursionTargets.ActualOriginalListRecursionCons := by
  intro body k base step α code head tail out params
  let C := consGraph code head tail
  let R := recGraph base step out code params
  let S := consStep base step out head tail params
  obtain ⟨forward⟩ := consForward (body := body) (Gamma := [R,C]) base step code head tail out params
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)⟩
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
  obtain ⟨backward⟩ := consBackward (body := body) (Gamma := [S,C]) base step code head tail out params
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)⟩
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction
    (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction (Derivation.implicationIntroduction forward)
      (Derivation.implicationIntroduction backward))⟩

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionProof

module

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenRowProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceBranchProof (zeroBranchIntro successorBranchIntro)
open ID1Completion.InternalEqualityTest (equalityTest)
open ID1Completion.InternalEqualityTestCompositionProof (equalityOfEqual)
open ID1Completion.InternalLessThan (constantOne)
open ID1Completion.InternalLessThanSupportProof (oneConstantValue)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (compositionValue projectionValue)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (eqn sucRelabel zRelabel)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (suc z)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeProof (optionGraphCases)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserOpenSyntaxProof (tripleInputsRename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathSuccessfulAdvanceGraphSyntaxProof (graph3Rename)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembership

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

private theorem onHead (h previous k : OTerm α)
    (same : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn h k))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph headMatches (suc z) ![h,previous,k])) := by
  let xs : Fin 3 → OTerm α := ![h,previous,k]
  apply compositionValue equalityTest (![.projection 0,.projection 2] : Fin 2 → Program 3)
    (suc z) xs ![h,k] (equalityOfEqual h k same)
  intro i
  exact Fin.cases (projectionValue 0 xs)
    (Fin.cases (projectionValue 2 xs) (fun noIndex => Fin.elim0 noIndex)) i

theorem stepHit (h previous k : OTerm α)
    (same : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn h k))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph memberStep (suc z) ![h,previous,k])) :=
  successorBranchIntro headMatches (.projection 1) (constantOne 3) (suc z) z ![h,previous,k]
    (onHead h previous k same) (oneConstantValue ![h,previous,k])

/-- If the actual recursive bit is one, either real head comparison
branch keeps it one. No numerical cut is reflected internally. -/
theorem stepKeep (h k : OTerm α) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph memberStep (suc z) ![h,suc z,k])) := by
  apply optionGraphCases headMatches (![h,suc z,k] : Fin 3 → OTerm α) _
  · intro β j Δ _ zero
    simp only [tripleInputsRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at zero
    simp only [graph3Rename,sucRelabel,zRelabel]
    let xs : Fin 3 → OTerm β := ![h.relabel j,suc z,k.relabel j]
    exact zeroBranchIntro headMatches (.projection 1) (constantOne 3) (suc z) xs zero
      (projectionValue 1 xs)
  · intro β j Δ prior _ nonzero
    simp only [tripleInputsRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at nonzero
    simp only [graph3Rename,sucRelabel,zRelabel]
    let xs : Fin 3 → OTerm β := ![h.relabel j,suc z,k.relabel j]
    exact successorBranchIntro headMatches (.projection 1) (constantOne 3) (suc z) prior xs nonzero
      (oneConstantValue xs)

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenRowProof

    (unaryGraph p out n).relabel j = unaryGraph p (out.relabel j) (n.relabel j) := by
  simp only [unaryGraph,programRename,consTermRename,emptyRename]

@[simp] theorem consGraphRename {β : Type} (n h t : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (consGraph n h t).relabel j = consGraph (n.relabel j) (h.relabel j) (t.relabel j) := by
  simp only [consGraph,programRename,consTermRename,emptyRename]

@[simp] theorem consResultRename {β : Type} (n h t : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (consResult n h t).relabel j = consResult (n.relabel j) (h.relabel j) (t.relabel j) := by
  change (unaryGraph headCode h n).relabel j ⊓
    ((unaryGraph tailCode t n).relabel j ⊓ ((eqn n z).relabel j).not) = _
  rw [unaryGraphRename,unaryGraphRename,eqnRelabel,zRelabel]
  rfl

theorem consValue (p h t : OTerm α)
